collector.registration: Closed LA/AK production adapter; authoritative lifecycle and exact immutable promotion evidence must both admit this cohort before any HTTP. Initial admitted output is on-site only, with all alert/watch/delivery flags false.

storeIdentity.proof: Current exact resolver banner/domain/host/store/address, source product/variant, UPC, format, strength, price and positive in-store channel must agree.

sourceSemantics.availability: Retailer-reported in-store availability. Exact reported integer quantities and binary availability with no exact count remain distinct. Verify before driving.
sourceSemantics.quantity: Exact positive integer retailer count when explicitly supplied; otherwise binary availability with quantity0 and quantityIsExact false.

stateFilter.assertion: Verified executable contract: actual Feed/drops route fixture applies state/store filters, and actual Dashboard component renders this lifecycle state choice. Authenticated UI acceptance is separate and unexercised.

areaFilter.assertion: Verified executable contract: actual store Finder/directory/locations and Coverage POST fixtures bind the closed cohort; actual area request builder uses the store query for this state.

preferences.assertion: Verified executable contract: real preferences GET/POST normalizes and deduplicates state choices, drops invalid states, preserves unrelated metadata, rejects free-tier writes with403 and signed-out requests with401. Clerk is an explicit offline provider adapter; no authenticated session claimed.

dashboard.assertion: Verified executable contract: actual Dashboard component renders with the real preferences route response and isolated active lifecycle fixture, including the state choice. Provider/data-hook/presentation boundaries are offline fixtures; interactive authenticated UI/device acceptance is unexercised.

dropFeedApi.assertion: Verified executable contract: actual unified Feed/drops route accepts strict nonpreview operational/export rows and applies exact state/store filters; no live source, provider delivery or authenticated session claimed.

finder.assertion: Verified executable contract: actual Finder search/exact-store services, selectable stores/locations routes and public Coverage GET/POST bind exact premises and current classified rows.

alerts.assertion: Verified executable contract: source, canonical, public, Feed and Coverage fixture paths preserve all inventory/watch/delivery/email/SMS flagsfalse. Free-tier preference mutations remain403; no provider delivery attempted.

monitoring.assertion: Verified executable runtime contract: inactive/force-live0HTTP, complete-cohort30min cache/original clocks, bounded deadlines, native durable denial/in-flight holds and abort behavior pass. Genuine unattended hosted observations remain separately pending.

export.assertion: Verified executable contract: actual canonical/public/normalized/classified export preserves nonpreview binary0 unknown and exact positive integer quantities, rejects identity/flag/quarantine mutations and expires original source clocks.

shadow.reason: Three future genuine workflow source observations are required; local preflight does not qualify.

canary.reason: Two future actual workflow canaries, live preview and exact implementation provenance are required.

production.assertion: This preparation does not activate a state, publish a snapshot or authorize customer delivery.
production.reason: A separate reviewed promotion and guarded release are required.

rollback.disableSource: Leave authoritative lifecycle inactive or disable/quarantine the state. Promotion admission runs before cache access and before HTTP; no fallback stock or outbound delivery is allowed.
